about: Price a farmer gets and the full cost of growing each crop, Tk per kg, from published Bangladeshi sources (each with its year). The cost covers everything: seed, ploughing, labour, fertiliser, irrigation, pesticide. Profit per bigha = FAOSTAT yield x (price - cost). Years differ between sources; the screen shows them.
